name: gp-producer-octroi-compliance
description: Guadeloupe reference for independent producers assessing internal octroi de mer liability and recurring compliance. Explains the prior-year production-turnover threshold, inclusive boundary, start-up proration, identification timing and quarterly electronic returns, with worked eligibility examples. Uses the 2026 statutory threshold and the official July 2025 customs circular, distinguishing production activity from resale and services. Product rates, local exemptions, deduction entitlements and detailed classification are outside this initial Guide. It does not establish complete Guadeloupe tax coverage, and independent source review and transaction-specific amendment checks remain necessary before operational use.
